title: Smartphone Apps for Tracking Food Consumption and Recommendations: Evaluating Artificial Intelligence-based Functionalities, Features and Quality of Current Apps
reasoning: The paper conducts a critical review and evaluation of smartphone apps for food consumption tracking and recommendations. It assesses app quality and features, including aspects like transparency and user impact on healthy behaviors. While it mentions data privacy and user behavior, it does not involve the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of its study.
